sentences.en: We must try to preserve the remains of ancient civilizations.
sentences.zh: 我们必须努力保存古代文明的遗迹。

sentences.en: As he didn't know what to say, he remained silent.
sentences.zh: 因为他不知道说什么，所以他保持沉默。

sentences.en: The saddest part of the story remains to be told.
sentences.zh: 这个故事最悲伤的部分还有待讲述。

senses.zh: 剩余物；残余 - 残骸；遗体 - 遗迹，遗址，废墟 -
留下，逗留 - 剩下，余留 - 留待 -

mnemonic: 词根记忆：re（一再）+main（逗留）→一再留下→剩下
